result.title: DIFFNAS: Predictor-Free Neural Architecture Search via Diffusion Model and Zero-Cost Evaluation
result.comment: 13 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Yize Sun and Hanzhang Ma contributed equally
result.summary: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has advanced the automated design of deep networks, but remains computationally expensive due to reliance on model training or performance predictors. We introduce DIFFNAS, a predictor-free NAS framework that leverages a discrete graph diffusion model guided by zero-cost performance proxies. Unlike prior diffusion-based NAS methods that require learned performance predictors, DIFFNAS conditions the generative process on training-free metrics such as MeCo and SWAP, enabling efficient architecture search with minimal computational overhead. Experiments on NAS-Bench-201 show that DIFFNAS finds the optimal architectures for CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 (94.37% and 73.51%) without a pretrained predictor, while reducing search cost by up to 17.5x compared to DiffusionNAG. On the MobileNetV3 search space, its accuracy is lower than that of DiffusionNAG. These results highlight the promise of diffusion models combined with zero-cost proxies for scalable and effective architecture search.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 DIFFNAS，用离散图扩散模型生成网络架构，并以 MeCo、SWAP 等零成本代理指标代替学习到的性能预测器来引导生成过程，在 NAS-Bench-201 与 MobileNetV3 空间上验证搜索效率与精度。
